key_point: GoldenEye was made by first-timers and its multiplayer was added in secret
title: Most of the team behind GoldenEye 007 had never made a game before.
caption: Most of the team behind GoldenEye 007 had never made a game before. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #goldeneye007 #n64 #rare

instagram.caption:
Most of the team behind GoldenEye 007 had never made a game before.

About ten people at Rare built it in a converted farmhouse in England. It took so long that it came out two years after the movie.

The famous four-player mode was added in the last months, without telling the bosses. It sold over 8 million copies.

Who always picked Oddjob?
